profile.summary: A nonprofit that operates a network of tuition-free public charter schools for students in kindergarten through 12th grade in California. Its schools are in the Bay Area, the Central Valley and Los Angeles regions. The organization was founded in 1998 and says it aims to prepare underserved students for college and career success.

sources.title: Aspire Public Schools - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: ProPublica (EIN 94-3311088, Oakland) and Aspire's contact and about pages support the name, EIN, address, phone, email, website, regions, founding year and mission; Aspire Public Schools is the nonprofit charter network that operates Aspire Berkley Maynard Academy in Oakland, which fits the charter facilities MOU. The summary is neutral and supported, though 'career success' loosely paraphrases the site's 'college and post-secondary pathways'.
